question: Who ascended the Gupta throne after Chandragupta I?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samudragupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Samudragupta was the successor of Chandragupta I.

 
 
• He is also called Napoleon of India because of his ambition of the military.
 
• He is regarded as the greatest ruler of the Gupta dynasty as he held major military campaigns.
 
• He is known for his first Aryavart war and Southern campaign.
 
• He ruled around 330-380 BC and contributed greatly to expanding the territory of the Gupta Empire.
 
• He is behind capturing of Ganga Yamuna doab.
